text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What do we need for the party~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Carrot sticks and juice, all good to go!
All prepared and vibing, Captain!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Splendid, Helios! Let us head back to the dorms while discussing which costumes to wear!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
K!
I'll be all wrapped in bandages... a m-m...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...She really is just pure mama material!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's the one! Wrap up that waist with bandages!
Let's glam it up and get hyped☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Go big, go big! Pile it on!
Then I'll get that too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I told you, it's Mummy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san, I'm home~
I bought the snacks you asked for as well,
so could you please take a look?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Creek, not you again!!
Good grief, whenever you wear that outfit...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Run, you guys! Hurry!
Don't let Creek catch you right now, or you're done for!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Front-running is my specialty!
Helios, let's run away!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Mama...
You can just call me Mama, you know...?
